lines.t: Thank you for the aching, the breaking I tried to evade
Thank you for your silence, to let all the lesser voices fade
I didn't want the empty
I didn't ask for band-aids
But the quiet road you carved for me
Became the one that saved
I used to hate the shadows
Where you stripped me of my pride
Now find your goodness
In the dark I tried to fight
Thank you for the breaking
That brought me back to you
Thank you for discomfort
That cut my idols loose
Thank you for a fine new blaze That turns my drawers to gold
I love the one you're forging me Less of me, more of yours
Thank you for the setbacks That kept me near the flame
Thank you for the closed doors that spared my soul from shame
Every no that broke my stride was the boundary of your grace
And every stumbling step I made led me to your embrace
I blamed you for the hurting
Till I learned to see the why love was pruning what would kill me
So your flow could fill my life
Thank you for the breaking
That brought me back to you
Thank you for discomfort
That cut my idols loose
Thank you for a fighting blaze
That turns my trust to gold
I love the one you're forging me
Less of me, more of yours
You walked with me in shadows
When I thought I walked alone
And now what is behind me
Is the reason I've come home
Refined, I am not ruined
You were kind in every blow
If this is how you love me, then burn what's left to go
Thank you for the breaking, that brought me back to you
Thank you for the discomfort, that cut my idols loose
Thank you for the lonely road that showed me what is true
I love the way you're remaking me
I'm not afraid of you
Thank you for the breaking
Thank you for the pain
Thank you for the mercy
Hidden in your flame
